title: Are We Being Lied to About Organic Food?
summary: Regenerative food-club host argues the organic label is undermined by fraud, barely inspected imports, confinement operations and hydroponics, while still cutting glyphosate exposure.

verdicts.note: Large fraud cases are documented, especially in imported grain, but there is no reliable measure of what share of organic food is mislabelled.

assertions.quote: only about 2% of farms in these group certifications internationally are inspected annually

verdicts.note: Under older rules certifiers inspected only a sample of group members and relied on internal control systems; the 2024 enforcement rule tightened this.

assertions.quote: developing countries are flooding the US market with organic products that don't meet the same standards as us organic products
this system is forcing us Growers who do comply with the strict organic standards out of business

verdicts.note: Cheap and sometimes fraudulent imports have depressed prices for some domestic organic grain and nut growers, though import competition has other causes too.

assertions.quote: most organic chicken and organic pork are raised in near total confinement
these kfo raised cows don't graze on grass in pasture
farmers can hire their own inspectors so it's like grading your own homework

verdicts.note: Operations do choose and pay accredited certifiers, a structural conflict, though USDA accredits and audits the certifiers.

assertions.quote: Hydroponics can be certified organic in the US despite not involving any soil

verdicts.note: USDA permits certification of hydroponic operations, a position upheld in federal court in 2022.

assertions.quote: these Farms often depend on intensive tillage methods to manage weeds

verdicts.note: Organic weed control often uses more tillage, which can harm soil structure, though organic systems still tend to have higher soil organic matter.

assertions.quote: an organic diet intervention reduced urinary glyphosate Levels by 70.9 3% and its main metaboli ampa by 76.7 1% within 6 days
a diet hire in organic food is also associated with a reduced risk of cancer
it's become more of a marketing term than anything else
often the best option that are produced with Beyond Organic standards don't even have that Organic certification
